Font Awesome SVG Icons
======================

MyWB includes SVG icons from Font Awesome.

MyWB includes modified and combined Font Awesome Free SVG icons.
Font Awesome Free uses separate license terms for icons, fonts, and code.
MyWB ships SVG icon assets only; those icons are licensed under the Creative
Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

Copyright Fonticons, Inc.

Some icons have been modified or combined for use in MyWB. Copyright notices
embedded in the SVG files are retained in the distributed icon files where
present.
